question: The autobiography of Nirad C Chaudhari is __________

options.text: The Autobiography of an Unknown Indian

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Autobiography of an Unknown Indian.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​Indian author Nirad C. Chaudhuri **published his autobiography in **1951** under the title **The Autobiography of an Unknown Indian.**
 
• When he was about **50 years old,** he wrote it.
 
• It chronicles his life beginning with his birth in the **small Bangladeshi town of Kishoreganj in 1897**.
